brief: Find qualified local support when no feasible repayment plan covers essential needs.

title.es-MX: Reconoce cuándo el plan necesita ayuda
title.pt-BR: Reconheça quando o plano precisa de ajuda

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Recognize when the plan needs help"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Reconoce cuándo el plan necesita ayuda"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Reconheça quando o plano precisa de ajuda"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Find qualified local support when no feasible repayment plan covers essential needs.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: If necessary costs and debts exceed available income, a budgeting trick cannot create the missing money.
instruction.misconception: Treating an impossible repayment budget as a failure of effort, or assuming another expensive loan always resolves it.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: When essentials and required payments exceed reliable income, record the gap. Seek qualified help to assess realistic options and consequences.
The stated figures show a capacity gap, not a character judgment.
Useful help requires a verifiable role and clear terms.
Decision-relevant records support advice; private access codes do not.
Moving debt does not resolve a repayment gap by itself.
Use official guidance to locate and check appropriate help.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: If necessary costs and debts exceed available income, a budgeting trick cannot create the missing money.

en-US.line: When essentials and required payments exceed reliable income, record the gap. Seek qualified help to assess realistic options and consequences.

es-MX.line: Si esenciales y pagos exigidos superan ingreso fiable, registra el faltante. Busca ayuda local calificada para evaluar opciones y consecuencias.

pt-BR.line: Se essenciais e pagamentos exigidos superam renda confiável, registre a falta. Busque ajuda local qualificada para avaliar opções e efeitos.
